glomeris detect — Find reclaimable candidates and how each is classified.

usage: glomeris detect [--project-root <path>]... [--json] [--progress-json]

Read-only — changes nothing.

Runs every detector, correlates the evidence each one produces, and prints the
candidates with their policy classification and size estimate. Deletes nothing
and sends nothing anywhere. A candidate's size is not a safety judgement: a
large AUTO_SAFE cache is an opportunity, and a small PROTECTED resource is
still protected.

Options
  --project-root <path>
      Scope the cargo and node detectors to this project. Repeatable. Does
      not bound the Xcode detector (which is $HOME-bounded) or the
      Homebrew and Docker detectors (which are bounded by neither).
  --json
      Print a DetectReport as JSON on stdout.
  --progress-json
      Stream one JSON progress event per line to stderr while detectors
      run. stdout stays a single clean document.

Examples
  glomeris detect
      What could I reclaim?
  glomeris detect --project-root ~/code/my-app --json
      Machine-readable, scoped to one project.

See also: explain, clean, free
